notes.title: New Update - v2.1.0
notes.content:
Hi guys! How are you today?

Banzo - Marks of Slavery has a new update, check it out!

-=-=-=-=-=-
v2.1.0
-=-=-=-=-=-

* [Campaign mode] Fixed a huge bug on the last mission of chapter 3.
* Minor bug fixes.

-=-=-=-=-=-


Please, report any other bugs in comments below.

notes.title: New Update - v2.0.5
notes.content:
Hi guys! How are you today?

Banzo - Marks of Slavery has a new update, check it out!

-=-=-=-=-=-
v2.0.5
-=-=-=-=-=-

* [Campaign mode] Save game system reworked. Player progress is automatically saved at the beginning of each turn.
* Minor bug fixes.

-=-=-=-=-=-


Please, report any other bugs in comments below.
